description: This file defines the Week class within the PhpSpreadsheet library, providing functions to calculate week numbers (WEEKNUM and ISOWEEKNUM), weekday calculations, and related date computations based on various standards and conventions.

classes.name: Week
classes.description: A class providing static methods to calculate week numbers and weekdays based on Excel date standards.

methods.name: number
methods.description: Calculates the week number for a given date, considering different week-start conventions.

methods.name: isoWeekNumber
methods.description: Calculates the ISO 8601 week number for a given date.

methods.name: day
methods.description: Returns the day of the week for a given date, formatted according to the specified style.
